title: Microsoft Teams: personal message reminders for chat and channels
summary: Hold: the impact rationale says every user will see toast notifications, whereas Microsoft's notice makes these conditional on reminders being due and existing notification settings. The sources also do not establish the claimed absence of prerequisites, the restriction to already-visible messages, or that the notification settings are exclusively personal.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity
claims.claim: The roadmap record and notice describe no change to sign-in or permissions.

claims.claim: Reminders only link back to messages the user can already see.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams message reminders source message permissions deleted prerequisites; Teams message reminders permissions. Read roadmap and MC1470887; they say reminders include message context, not that access is limited to messages currently visible to the user.
claims.fix: Remove 'The reminder follows the message context the user already has.' In the risk rationale, replace 'Reminders are private to each user and only link back to messages the user can already see' with 'Reminders are private to each user'.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: The sources describe no autonomous behaviour beyond the user-managed reminders and due notifications.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams personal message reminders Reminders view; Teams message reminders source message permissions. Read roadmap and MC1470887: user-created, managed and deleted reminders and due notifications are described; no further autonomous action is specified.
